paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the performance changes of two models, Ours and ReFICR, with respect to the depth of search, measured by Recall@50 and NDCG@50. The x-axis represents the depth of search, labeled numerically from 1 to 5 with an interval of 1, and a linear scale. The left and right y-axes represent Recall@50 and NDCG@50, respectively, both with linear scales ranging from 0.3 to 0.6 and 0.10 to 0.35, respectively, and tick labels at intervals of 0.05 and 0.05. There are four lines in the plot: the green solid line represents Recall@50 (Ours), starting at approximately 0.35 and increasing to around 0.57; the green dotted line represents Recall@50 (ReFICR), remaining steady at around 0.32; the blue solid line represents NDCG@50 (Ours), starting at approximately 0.43 and increasing to around 0.52; and the blue dotted line represents NDCG@50 (ReFICR), remaining steady at around 0.13.
